name: Micro Invaders
startup:
# Initialize the model and install keyboard shortcuts without executing external code.
self.timer = None
self.generation = 0
self.running = False
game_reset(self)
self.Board.bind('<Left>', lambda event: invader_move(self, -22))
self.Board.bind('<Right>', lambda event: invader_move(self, 22))
self.Board.bind('<space>', lambda event: invader_shoot(self))
self.Form1.protocol('WM_DELETE_WINDOW', lambda: game_close(self))
self.Form1.deiconify()
